description: This file declares the interface IHealthcheckService for health check operations within the rialto::servermanager::common namespace. It defines virtual methods for handling ping sent, acknowledgment received, and server removal events.
external_methods: virtual void onPingSent(int serverId, int pingId)
virtual void onAckReceived(int serverId, int pingId, bool success)

classes.name: IHealthcheckService
classes.description: Interface class for health check services, providing virtual methods to be implemented for handling health check events.

methods.name: onPingSent
methods.description: Called when a ping is sent to a server, with server ID and ping ID.

methods.name: onAckReceived
methods.description: Called when an acknowledgment is received from a server, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: onServerRemoved
methods.description: Called when a server is removed from the system.
